# Ferry timetable change — 2026-10-09

**Participants:** Tamsin Oduya (Operations), Rolf Benedek (Dispatcher)

Tamsin: "The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November. The late sailing carried under ten passengers a night."

Rolf: "The weekend timetable stays as it is; Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill."

### Narrative_VulnerabilityDrivenSensorRolloutAndTelemetryCadence
type: Narrative
witnessed: 20261009
frame: "What deployment deadlines, bay prioritization criteria, and measurement cadences govern greenhouse microclimate protection?"
members performed: commitment-marker ×2 · performed-act · plain-assertion · 2026-10-09
source: Sample_20261009_1_Batch1Greenhouse20261009043208_h887d2e3c8854
members (4):
  · Expr_20261009_1_Batch1Greenhouse20261009043208_h887d2e3c8854_1 — "We install humidity sensors in all four greenhouse bays before the first frost."
  · Expr_20261009_1_Batch1Greenhouse20261009043208_h887d2e3c8854_2 — "Bay two gets the pilot unit first, because it lost the most seedlings last winter."
  · Expr_20261009_1_Batch1Greenhouse20261009043208_h887d2e3c8854_3 — "Agreed."
  · Expr_20261009_1_Batch1Greenhouse20261009043208_h887d2e3c8854_4 — "The sensors report every fifteen minutes; anything slower misses the overnight drop."
Prioritizing sensor installation by past seedling loss and enforcing high-frequency reporting to capture overnight microclimate shifts
under: GreenhouseSensorDeployment

### Narrative_CommuterTargetedEarlyHoursWithStaffingOffset
type: Narrative
witnessed: 20261009
frame: "How should branch library operating hours adjust to capture commuter traffic while preserving flat staffing baselines?"
members performed: plain-assertion ×2 · 2026-10-09
source: Sample_20261009_3_Batch5Library20261009043208_hcfdc1ab0c2a6
members (2):
  · Expr_20261009_3_Batch5Library20261009043208_hcfdc1ab0c2a6_1 — "We open at eight on Tuesdays and Thursdays so the commuter crowd can return books on the way in."
  · Expr_20261009_3_Batch5Library20261009043208_hcfdc1ab0c2a6_2 — "And we close an hour earlier those days to keep the staffing flat."
Balancing early commuter access with reciprocal early closing offsets to maintain flat staffing
under: BranchLibraryOperations

### Narrative_MiddayMarkdownAndShelfCardSynchronization
type: Narrative
witnessed: 20261009
frame: "How should day-old markdowns and shelf-edge pricing be timed and synchronized to maximize sales before closing and ensure checkout transparency?"
members performed: plain-assertion ×3 · intensifier · 2026-10-09
source: Sample_20261009_2_Batch2Bakery20261009043208_h4af79d12c044
members (3):
  · Expr_20261009_2_Batch2Bakery20261009043208_h4af79d12c044_1 — "Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon, not at close."
  · Expr_20261009_2_Batch2Bakery20261009043208_h4af79d12c044_2 — "At close nobody is left to buy them."
  · Expr_20261009_2_Batch2Bakery20261009043208_h4af79d12c044_3 — "Then the shelf card changes at two as well, so the price is never a surprise at the till."
Timing markdowns during active afternoon traffic while synchronizing shelf cards to eliminate till surprises
under: BakeryPricing
